desc:
✨ Welcome to OMG Pets! ✨

Fuse and flex unique pets, invite your friends and have fun!

[UPDATE v1.1.3]
❓❓❓
🌳 Auto sell foods drooped from tree!
🧙 Merchant now sells past event eggs!
🚀 Max Rebirth increased to 60!
🌈 Rainbow and ✨Shining food upgrades!

🥚 Hatch Eggs!
🦄 Fuse Pets!
🤩 Evolve Pets!
🍎 Feed Pets for cool perks!
🍲 Craft exclusive foods!
♻️ Rebirth and keep your strongest pets!

🤝 Gifting system - give pets 🐾 and food 🍗 to other players!
😴 AFK system - ⏳ stay AFK for HOURS without being kicked! 😎

Remember, you can earn Coins offline!

⭐ Like and favorite the game!
